description: Renovate for the BASE repo: PECL pins in the Dockerfile, GitHub Action digests, and the third-party images the examples run. PHP and Alpine are NOT here on purpose — the weekly workflow resolves them to the newest upstream digest on every run.

ignorePaths REPLACES config:recommended's list, which includes **/examples/** and **/test/**. That replacement is what lets Renovate see examples/ at all: drop this ignorePaths (or restore the preset's list) and the examples/** package rules below silently stop matching anything.

customManagers.description: PECL extension versions pinned as ARGs, each preceded by a `# renovate:` comment

packageRules.description: One PR for all PECL bumps: the PR's CI run proves them on every PHP line and both architectures together
PECL minor/patch bumps merge themselves once CI is green; the next build ships them. A major bump stays a PR for a human.
Actions are pinned by digest; minor/patch/digest bumps merge themselves once CI is green
Images the examples run (Postgres, MariaDB, Traefik, socket proxy, Portainer, Node): a PR each, never automerged — a database or edge-proxy bump needs a human to read its release notes

php-base digests in the examples pin a published build so a copied example builds as is; the copied project's own renovate.json keeps them current. App-image references are placeholders. Neither is a dependency of this repo
